# sflow

> Declarative workflow descriptor (YAML) with swappable backends. Describe a workflow once
> — tasks, dependencies, resources, and launch methods — and run it on Slurm or locally
> (Docker and Kubernetes planned). sflow ships AI agent skills for writing and debugging
> sflow YAML, installable with `sflow skill`.

## Agent skills

- [Agent skills overview](https://nvidia.github.io/nv-sflow/docs/agents/intro): what ships and how agents use it
- [Setup](https://nvidia.github.io/nv-sflow/docs/agents/setup): `sflow skill` install and per-tool wiring
- [Writing sflow YAML](https://nvidia.github.io/nv-sflow/docs/agents/writing-sflow-yaml/): authoring skill
- [Error analysis](https://nvidia.github.io/nv-sflow/docs/agents/sflow-error-analysis/): debugging skill
- [AGENTS.md guidelines](https://nvidia.github.io/nv-sflow/docs/agents/agents-guidelines): authoring workflow and rules
